pr_title: Bluetooth: Audio: CAP: babblesim test for broadcast reception start
pr_body:
Add a babblesim test for the broadcast reception start procedure from the CAP commander

fixes #68291

issue_context.title: Bluetooth: LE Audio: CAP commander: Broadcast Reception Start procedure babblesim test
issue_context.body:
**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
Add a babblesim test for verification of the implementation mentioned in issue #64358 

**Describe the solution you'd like**
Implement a babblesim test

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
A unittest is implemented for parameter checking, see #68869

**Additional context**
see #64358

review_comments:
This doesn't really work as the broadcast assistant does not support multiple connections until https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/73694 is merged. 

I think it works because all the acceptors are identical and thus have the same handles etc.

We should either restrict the test to a single CAP acceptor and/or add a comment here.
We could also consider moving the PA sync create to a common file like we have for ACL, as we use that quite a few places now
This may also apply for several other functions in this PR
Idem, let's do it as a separate task, so that we can move the other functions, and update the other places these are used
Suggest to define this in the common file - I guess we are using it multiple places in BSIM?
A good idea, but let's do it as a separate task, so that we can update the other places it is used at the same time
keeping it so that original and copy stay in sync, plan is to move these into a common section
Shouldn't this be guarded with PAST support?

Suggest to move the error handling and state check into the `pa_sync_create` function itself, so this becomes

```suggestion
	pa_sync_create();
```


as we discussed. 

This significantly cleans up the main test functions. 


This also applies for the other error checks and state changes in this function
This test function was copied from the test_cap_acceptor_broadcast test, so that one should than be changed as well. So I propose to do it in a separate PR as a cleanup job

> This test function was copied from the test_cap_acceptor_broadcast test, so that one should than be changed as well. So I propose to do it in a separate PR as a cleanup job

I disagree. There's no point in adding new functions to just fix them later. Makes more sense to add them "correctly" the first time
The function pa_sync_create already existed in this module. Cleanup implies modifying existing tests, and will be done in a separate PR
